title: Ultra-Local Model
text: Estimate nonlinear plant as single or double integrator systems with an affine term that captures unknown dynamics and disturbances, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Input gain (α)}, {Model Order} sets the ultra-local model order, {Estimator sample time}, {Integration window (steps)}, {Include current time inputs for F estimation} sets the include current time inputs for estimation, {Output estimated yhat} sets the output one-step estimation of output and {Observer gain (L)}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Fhat
ports.summary: Estimated disturbances and unmodeled dynamics scalar

params.name: Integration window (steps)
params.values: Integration window 3 (default) | positive integer greater than 3

params.name: Include current time inputs for F estimation
params.values: Include current time inputs for estimation off (default) | on

params.name: Output estimated yhat
params.values: Output one-step estimation of output off (default) | on
